cases.label: Partial project cut review
cases.prompt_text: A short assembled cut should stay honest about partial scene coverage while still presenting a coherent playable clip from the rendered material that exists.
cases.expectation_note: A partial assembled cut can validate its sampled-media coherence when omission truth is explicit; this does not prove cross-scene final-render quality.

cases.label: Complete project cut review
cases.prompt_text: A complete assembled cut should play as one coherent project-level output and surface any visible readability issues as review-worthy warnings rather than blocking failures.
cases.expectation_note: The assembled media is mechanically complete and sampled-media coherent; repeated synthetic source clips mean this case does not prove inter-scene creative coherence.

cases.label: Missing project cut file
cases.prompt_text: A complete assembled cut should play as one coherent project-level output and surface any visible readability issues as review-worthy warnings rather than blocking failures.
cases.expectation_note: Missing final-output media is a blocking runtime failure.

cases.label: Corrupt project cut decode
cases.prompt_text: A short assembled cut should stay honest about partial scene coverage while still presenting a coherent playable clip from the rendered material that exists.
cases.expectation_note: Corrupt final-output media that cannot decode is a blocking runtime failure.
